zadanie: Kim has $10$ identical lamps and $3$ identical tables. How many ways are there for her to put all the lamps on the tables?
oczekiwana_odpowiedz:
Only the number of lamps on each table matters, so we can list the possibilities systematically:  \begin{align*}
(&10,0,0) \\
& (9,1,0) \\
& (8,2,0) \\
& (8,1,1) \\
& (7,3,0) \\
& (7,2,1) \\
& (6,4,0) \\
& (6,3,1) \\
& (6,2,2) \\
& (5,5,0) \\
& (5,4,1) \\
& (5,3,2) \\
& (4,4,2) \\
& (4,3,3)
\end{align*}There are a total of $\boxed{14}$ possibilities.
